summary.goal: Define the core domain entities for Ideation: Session and Understanding. These form the foundation for the entire package. Intelligence lives in agent prompts, not schemas - schemas are freeform containers.

acceptance_criteria.description: Session entity has: id, status, initiative_id?, source, transcript[], understanding, planner_sends[], active_specialists[], timestamps
Session status enum: 'active' | 'abandoned'
Understanding is freeform: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> - keyed by specialist name/role
Each specialist's observations structure is freeform (agent prompts define what to contribute)
active_specialists[] tracks currently spawned specialist agent IDs for this session
Confidence is agent-reported, not schema-enforced (agents decide their own confidence representation)
Transcript message has: id, role ('user' | 'assistant'), content, timestamp
PlannerSend captures: sent_at, payload (goal, context?, source, understanding, initiative_id?), result (plan_id, plan_version)
planner_sends[] is append-only history of all sends to planner
Minimal Zod schemas - validate structure, not content (intelligence in prompts)
TypeScript types are exported for use across packages

decisions.rationale: Intelligence lives in agent prompts, not Zod schemas. Any specialist type, any observation structure.
Specialists are spawned dynamically based on conversation needs. Not limited to predefined 5.
Understanding is live state, sent to planner as snapshot. Simpler model.
User can continue ideating after sending to planner, send again for replanning
Specialists never appear in chat - Interviewer facilitates without revealing who originated a question

steps.title: Define minimal enums and primitive types
steps.description: Create Zod schemas for minimal structural enums only (not content constraints)

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionStatus = z.enum(['active', 'abandoned'])
TranscriptRole = z.enum(['user', 'assistant'])
No GuardianRole enum - specialists are dynamic
No Confidence enum - agents define their own confidence representation

steps.title: Define freeform Understanding schema
steps.description: Create minimal Zod schema for Understanding as freeform record

acceptance_criteria.description: Understanding = z.record(z.string(), z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()))
Keys are specialist names (e.g., 'Architect', 'DataModeller', or any other)
Values are freeform objects - structure defined by agent prompts, not schema

steps.title: Define TranscriptMessage schema
steps.description: Create Zod schema for individual transcript messages (user and assistant only)

acceptance_criteria.description: TranscriptMessage = { id: string, role: TranscriptRole, content: string, timestamp: string }

steps.title: Define PlannerSend schema
steps.description: Create Zod schema for capturing exact payload sent to planner

acceptance_criteria.description: PlannerSendPayload = { goal: string, context?: string, source: { type: 'ideation', session_id: string }, understanding: Understanding, initiative_id?: string }
PlannerSendResult = { plan_id: string, plan_version: number }
PlannerSend = { sent_at: string, payload: PlannerSendPayload, result: PlannerSendResult }

steps.title: Define ActiveSpecialist schema
steps.description: Track spawned specialists for a session

acceptance_criteria.description: ActiveSpecialist = { name: string, agent_id: string, spawned_at: string, role_hint?: string }
name is the specialist identifier used in Understanding keys
role_hint is optional description of specialist focus (for UI display)

steps.title: Define Session schema
steps.description: Create Zod schema for Session entity with all fields

acceptance_criteria.description: Session = { id, status, initiative_id?, source: { type: 'human', initial_intent }, transcript[], understanding, active_specialists[], planner_sends[], created_at, updated_at }

steps.title: Define aggregate confidence computation
steps.description: Function to compute overall confidence from specialist observations

acceptance_criteria.description: computeAggregateConfidence(understanding) returns 0-100 score
Looks for 'confidence' key in each specialist's observations (freeform)
Maps string values: 'exploring'->25, 'forming'->50, 'confident'->90 (convention)
Returns average of all specialists, or 0 if none have reported

steps.title: Export types and create index
steps.description: Export all TypeScript types from Zod schemas and create domain/index.ts barrel

acceptance_criteria.description: packages/ideation/src/domain/index.ts exports all schemas and inferred types
Types: Session, Understanding, TranscriptMessage, PlannerSend, ActiveSpecialist, etc.
